_README: Native-panel output for our-day. REBUILD, NEVER TRANSLATE (§A.13.48). Each panel was handed the English as a SOURCE TO AUDIT, not a target. Their sourceDefects lists are kept here on purpose: three of the findings were bugs in the MODEL, not the copy — tomorrowChip erasing a promised weekday, weekdayLabel capitalising mid-sentence, and noticeLong being unreachable behind an input maxLength. Consumed by apply-our-day-locales.js.

sourceDefects: recentLbl 'Used often' was FALSE: _noteRecent is a most-recently-used stack with no counters. Ten locales inherited the lie.
noticeLong was a DEAD STRING in all 11 locales: inp.maxLength = MAX_NAME made addCustom's length branch unreachable. Cap removed so the message can do its job.
makeHint 'Children will see the picture, not the words' was FALSE — the name renders as text on every card face.
soonFrame 'Soon it's {a}.' imposed different grammar from NOW_FRAME 'Now it's time for {a}!' and broke on the new labels ('Soon it's Coats on.'). Made parallel.
RESCOPE.language.en = 'English lesson' collided head-on with the new mothertongue card in an English-medium school.
skipCard and skipNoDay were byte-identical: the teacher taps 'Another day', is asked which day, and is offered 'Another day' again.
makeTitle did two jobs — the sheet heading AND the create tile's label. Split into makeNew.
moreChip 'Show the tools' — there is no tools concept in this UI; the button leaves display mode.
setWarn called a gentle heads-up a 'warning', in a tool whose register forbids alarm.
noticeLong said 'letters' but MAX_NAME counts characters; noticeFull omitted deleting, which is the likelier way out; makeDeviceOnly said 'computer' for a tool run from a whiteboard or tablet.
SYSTEMIC: the capitalised card label was dropped mid-sentence into 7 frames while only nowSentence/soonFrame consulted ANNOUNCE — wrong in the 9 locales that lowercase subject names.
SYSTEMIC: weekdayLabel force-capitalised through _cap and the result landed mid-sentence AND on the printed substitute sheet.

strings.setWarn: Two taps to move on — the first one says “soon”.
strings.makeHint: Children who are not reading yet go by the picture — pick one that says it on its own.
strings.makeDeviceOnly: Your cards stay in this browser, on this device.
strings.noticeFull: That’s twelve cards — the most you can keep. Edit or delete one you already have.
strings.noticeLong: That name is a bit long for the board — twenty characters is the most it will hold.
strings.noticeDup: You already have a card like this one — same name, or same picture and colour.
strings.noticeEmpty: Give the card a name first.

sourceDefects: setWarn said 'Deux touches' — in French une touche is a keyboard KEY, not a tap.
makeTitle was the only tu-form among otherwise consistent vous teacher strings.
removedOnDay began with the article-baked lowercase card name and then capitalised the weekday — both wrong, and it PRINTS on the substitute sheet.

strings.setWarn: Avancer en deux fois — le premier signal dit « bientôt ».
strings.makeHint: Les enfants qui ne lisent pas encore se fient à l’image — choisissez-en une qui dit tout.
strings.makeDeviceOnly: Vos cartes restent dans ce navigateur, sur cet appareil.
strings.noticeFull: Cela fait douze cartes — c’est le maximum. Modifiez-en une ou supprimez-en une.
strings.noticeLong: Ce nom ne tient pas sur la carte — vingt caractères au maximum.
strings.noticeDup: Vous avez déjà une carte comme celle-ci — même nom, ou même image et même couleur.
strings.noticeEmpty: Donnez d’abord un nom à la carte.

sourceDefects: soonFrame said 'Ahora' one step BEFORE the sun moves, colliding with NOW_FRAME, and 'viene' broke number agreement on the plural card names the file ships.
makeDeviceOnly said 'ordenador' and noticeLong 'pizarra' — both peninsular, in an es-MX build.
makeAdd/addCardAria said 'Añadir' while the file's own es lexicon already says 'Agregar'.
RULING: lunch 'la comida' is the main meal eaten AT HOME after primaria ends — changed to 'el almuerzo'.

announce.helper: el turno del ayudante del día

strings.setWarn: Dos toques para avanzar — el primero dice “ahorita”.
strings.makeHint: Los niños que aún no leen se guían por el dibujo — elige uno que lo diga todo.
strings.makeDeviceOnly: Tus tarjetas se quedan en este navegador, en este dispositivo.
strings.noticeFull: Son doce tarjetas — el máximo. Edita o borra una que ya tengas.
strings.noticeLong: Ese nombre no cabe en la tarjeta — veinte caracteres como máximo.
strings.noticeDup: Ya tienes una tarjeta así — con el mismo nombre, o con el mismo dibujo y color.
strings.noticeEmpty: Primero ponle un nombre a la tarjeta.

sourceDefects: THE SPEC LEFT A DUPLICATE CARD: mothertongue takes 'l'italiano' but the old italiano card was not in REMOVE, so the Italian palette would have shown it twice. Added to REMOVE.
classmeeting collided with the existing assembly card — both 'assemblea'. Differentiated as 'l'assemblea di classe'.
'il consiglio di classe' would have been WRONG — in Italy that is the teachers' body, not the pupils' meeting.

strings.dayDoneSpoken: Questa è stata la nostra giornata.
strings.setWarn: Due tocchi per andare avanti — il primo dice « fra poco ».
strings.makeTitle: Dai un nome a questa carta
strings.makeHint: I bambini che non leggono ancora si affidano all’immagine — scegline una che dica tutto.
strings.makeDeviceOnly: Le tue carte restano in questo browser, su questo dispositivo.
strings.noticeFull: Sono dodici carte — il massimo. Modificane una o eliminane una.
strings.noticeLong: Questo nome non ci sta sulla carta — al massimo venti caratteri.
strings.noticeDup: Hai già una carta così — stesso nome, oppure stessa immagine e stesso colore.
strings.noticeEmpty: Prima dai un nome alla carta.

sourceDefects: TRAP THAT WOULD HAVE SHIPPED: 'o simulado' means a MOCK EXAM in Brazil — one of the most anxiety-loaded words a Brazilian pupil knows. A card meant to reassure an autistic child would have announced a practice test. Used 'o treino de evacuação'.
NAMES.science pt was 'ciências' — the only pt card with no determiner, against the file's own baked-article convention. Corrected to 'as ciências'.
classmeeting collided with the existing assembly card; differentiated as 'a assembleia da turma'.

strings.setWarn: Dois toques para avançar — o primeiro diz “daqui a pouco”.
strings.makeTitle: Dê um nome a este cartão
strings.makeHint: As crianças que ainda não leem se guiam pela imagem — escolha uma que diga tudo.
strings.makeDeviceOnly: Seus cartões ficam neste navegador, neste aparelho.
strings.noticeFull: São doze cartões — o máximo. Edite ou exclua um que você já tem.
strings.noticeLong: Esse nome não cabe no cartão — no máximo vinte caracteres.
strings.noticeDup: Você já tem um cartão assim — mesmo nome, ou mesma imagem e mesma cor.
strings.noticeEmpty: Primeiro dê um nome ao cartão.

sourceDefects: RULING: religion 'Kristendom' names the FAITH; the folkeskole subject is Kristendomskundskab. Label corrected, with ANNOUNCE 'kristendom' for the spoken line.
tomorrowChip 'Byg i morgen' reads as 'build [it] tomorrow' — 'i morgen' is adverbial and cannot be the object of 'byg'.
makeAdd said 'Føj til dagen' while changeAddB/A already say 'Tilføj'. One verb, two forms.

strings.setWarn: To tryk for at gå videre — det første siger “om lidt”.
strings.makeHint: De mindste går efter billedet — vælg et, der siger det hele.
strings.makeDeviceOnly: Dine kort bliver i denne browser, på denne enhed.
strings.noticeFull: Det er tolv kort — flere kan ikke gemmes. Rediger eller slet et, du allerede har.
strings.noticeLong: Navnet er lidt langt til tavlen — højst tyve tegn.
strings.noticeDup: Du har allerede et kort som dette — samme navn, eller samme billede og farve.

sourceDefects: RULING: crafts 'Forming' is the pre-1997 subject name, abolished with L97, while `art` already holds the current Kunst og håndverk. But 'forming' is still the live everyday word for making things with children — 'Formingsstund' keeps it and drops the subject reading.
tomorrowChip 'Bygg i morgen' — same adverbial trap as Danish.
setWarn 'varsel' leans formal/official; naming what the first tap says is better than either word.

strings.setWarn: To trykk for å gå videre — det første sier «snart».
strings.makeHint: De minste går etter bildet — velg ett som sier alt.
strings.makeDeviceOnly: Kortene dine blir i denne nettleseren, på denne enheten.
strings.noticeFull: Det er tolv kort — flere kan ikke lagres. Endre eller slett ett du allerede har.
strings.noticeLong: Navnet er litt langt for tavla — høyst tjue tegn.
strings.noticeDup: Du har allerede et kort som dette — samme navn, eller samme bilde og farge.

sourceDefects: UNGRAMMATICAL AS SHIPPED: removedOnDay '{name} siirtyy {day}.' with a NOMINATIVE weekday. Finnish needs the allative (maanantaille). Rewritten so both placeholders sit sentence-initially and it is correct either way.
RULING: religion 'Katsomusaine' names a CATEGORY of subject, not a lesson, and no Finnish teacher writes it on a wall. ANNOUNCE.fi already held the right word — 'katsomustunti'. Label made to match.
GLOSS WRONG WORD: changepe 'vaihtaminen' means swapping/exchanging, not changing clothes. A build from the gloss would have shipped a card reading 'Swapping' to Finnish six-year-olds.
MISSING TIME_NAMES rows: four new cards cannot be sentence subjects, so the premium time frame would emit 'the special-ed teacher begins…' and a plural subject with a singular verb.

strings.makeHint: Pienimmät katsovat kuvaa — valitse kuva, joka kertoo kaiken.
strings.makeDeviceOnly: Korttisi säilyvät tässä selaimessa, tällä laitteella.
strings.noticeFull: Kaksitoista korttia on enimmäismäärä. Muokkaa tai poista jokin vanha kortti.
strings.noticeLong: Nimi on taululle vähän pitkä — enintään kaksikymmentä merkkiä.
strings.noticeDup: Sinulla on jo tällainen kortti — sama nimi, tai sama kuva ja väri.

sourceDefects: setWarn 'Tipper' is not German for a screen tap — it means a person who places a bet (Lotto-Tipper).

RULING: religion needs a SECOND card. One card labelled 'Religion' is false for roughly half of every German class, and both halves physically leave for different rooms — which is exactly what this tool exists to show. New card `ethics` = 'Ethik'.
emptyHint said 'links' — and the code comment claiming direction words were gone from every locale was FALSE; only en had been cleaned.
makeDelete over-promises: it removes the card from the PALETTE only, so a teacher who deletes and still sees it will think the tool is broken.
noticeFull was ambiguous between two different limits — MAX_CUSTOM 12 (own cards) and MAX_CARDS 16 (the whole day).
moreChip 'Werkzeuge zeigen' collides with the product's own noun for an instrument — it suggests navigating to OTHER tools.

PARALLEL ACTIVITIES ARE NOT REPRESENTABLE: the strip is linear and cannot express 'half the class does A in another room'. True of Förderstunde and Sprachförderung too. Recorded as a model limit, not fixed.

strings.setWarn: Zweimal tippen zum Weitergehen — der erste Tipp sagt „gleich“.
strings.makeHint: Die Kinder erkennen die Karte am Bild — der Name ist für dich.
strings.makeDeviceOnly: Deine Karten bleiben nur in diesem Browser, auf diesem Gerät.
strings.noticeFull: Mehr als zwölf eigene Karten gehen nicht — bearbeite oder lösche eine davon.
strings.noticeLong: Der Name ist für die Karte etwas lang — höchstens zwanzig Zeichen.
strings.noticeDup: So eine Karte gibt es schon — gleicher Name, oder gleiches Bild und gleiche Farbe.
strings.noticeEmpty: Gib der Karte zuerst einen Namen.

sourceDefects: ⚠ FOUND BY CC WHILE VERIFYING A PANEL CLAIM, NOT BY ANY PANEL: firstFrame and afterFrame wrapped the announce form in _cap, and Dutch is the ONE locale whose announce table is deliberately lowercase — so the tool spoke 'Met De kring begint onze dag.'
changeSpoken was filled with announceName when SPOKEN and cardName when PRINTED — the same sentence, two fill functions, and the printed sheet ignored the ANNOUNCE table that exists for it.
SHIPPED CARD DEFECT: art nl 'Knutselen' IS crafts. The Dutch subject pair is tekenen + handvaardigheid, so the two cards were the same activity twice.
SHIPPED CARD DEFECT: guest nl 'Invaljuf of invalmeester' is 24 characters — the longest label in the Dutch set and over the tool's own 18-character flag.
nextLbl 'Daarna' contradicted the tool's own vocabulary — focusChip already ships 'Nu en straks'. Three words for one relation is what a visual-schedule child cannot afford.
moreChip: THE DUTCH WAS RIGHT AND THE ENGLISH WAS WRONG. The button restores the toolbar; this tool has no 'tools'.
tomorrowChip: the ENGLISH is the misleading one — 'build' implies from scratch, which is exactly what the handler does not do.

strings.setWarn: Twee tikken om verder te gaan — de eerste zegt „straks”.
strings.makeHint: Jonge kinderen lezen de naam nog niet — kies een plaatje dat zij meteen herkennen.
strings.makeDeviceOnly: Je kaartjes blijven in deze browser, op dit apparaat — ergens anders zie je ze niet.
strings.noticeFull: Dat zijn twaalf kaartjes — het maximum. Pas er een aan of verwijder er een.
strings.noticeLong: Die naam is wat lang voor het kaartje — hoogstens twintig tekens.
strings.noticeDup: Je hebt al zo’n kaartje — dezelfde naam, of hetzelfde plaatje en dezelfde kleur.
strings.noticeEmpty: Geef het kaartje eerst een naam.

sourceDefects: ⚠ FOUND BY THE PANEL READING THE MODEL: soonFrame called announceName WITHOUT the snap argument that every other announce site passes — so the ONE announcement aimed at the child who cannot cope with a sudden switch could speak a name that does not match the card on the wall.

RULING AGAINST THE BRIEF'S OWN SUGGESTION, and it matters: 'först–sedan' is the established Swedish SEN term, and that is exactly why it must NOT be used — in Swedish practice a först–sedan-tavla IS the contingency board the tool's REFUSE #5 forbids. 'Nu och sedan' kept.

RULING: religion stays ONE card as 'SO'. In lågstadiet the four samhällsorienterande ämnen are genuinely timetabled as one block, and splitting would break parity with the identical NO card. The cross-to-globe icon change is correct and overdue.
makeAdd 'Lägg till i dagen' collides with a live Swedish idiom — 'lägga i dagen' means to display or manifest.
dayDoneSpoken: heard rather than read, 'vår dag' sits next to the compound 'vårdag' (a spring day), and word-boundary prosody is what TTS cannot be relied on for.
moreChip 'Visa verktygen' collides with the product noun — this product calls each instrument a verktyg.
makeDelete over-promises in every locale: it removes from the PALETTE only.

strings.setWarn: Två tryck för att gå vidare (med förvarning först)
strings.makeHint: Barnen läser bilden — namnet är för dig och för utskriften.
strings.makeDeviceOnly: Dina kort stannar i den här webbläsaren, på den här enheten.
strings.noticeFull: Det är tolv kort — fler går inte att spara. Ändra eller ta bort ett du redan har.
strings.noticeLong: Namnet är lite långt för kortet — högst tjugo tecken.
strings.noticeDup: Du har redan ett kort som ser likadant ut — samma namn, eller samma bild och färg.
